# Working Set

<!-- Task-scoped scratch state (spec §23.4). Start a working copy at the repo
     root with `make working-set`; it is gitignored (/WORKING_SET.md) and is
     never committed. Keep it current while you work — it is the handoff
     surface if the task is interrupted, and the checklist source when the
     task closes (journal entry, beads tickets for open questions). -->

**Task**: <beads id / slug — e.g. mtc-xyz "short title">
**Branch**: <branch name>
**Started**: <YYYY-MM-DD>

## Files touched

<!-- Every file created/modified/deleted, one per line, with why. Prune
     entries you revert; this list should match the final diff. -->

- `path/to/file` — why

## Decisions made

<!-- Decisions taken during this task, with rejected alternatives. Before
     closing the task, promote anything non-trivial to the journal
     (`make journal msg="..."`) and to docs/adr/ when it deserves a
     standalone record (.claude/rules/document-decisions.md). -->

- decision — rationale (rejected: alternative, because ...)

## Open questions

<!-- Unresolved items you are leaving behind. Before closing the task: file a
     beads ticket for each, then record them in the closing journal entry. -->

- question (ticket: —)
